name: fireguard-iot
description: FireGuard IoT — Premium fire alarm monitoring and control platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm run start --prefix apps/api" "npm run start --prefix apps/web"
